svg.text: Retention does not pick the winner either
7 models with both a retention and a token series. Across: weekly retention. Up: share of OpenCode tokens.
Correlation is +0.25 (Pearson), rank rho=+0.50. A model can be sticky and small; a model can be leaky and huge.
session cost per 1M tokens · rho=-0.49, n=6
The retention–usage correlation is not stable
Retention snapshot × trailing 28-day usage; one point per archived snapshot. n=4–6.
The highest-retention model is not the most-used, and the most-used is not the stickiest. n=7; a correlation this small is not evidence.
No promotional-discount field exists in OpenCode's feed. Effective price is session cost ÷ tokens per session: it includes cache and token mix, not a discount.
Retention snapshots: 02 Oct, 15 Oct, 24 Oct, 26 Oct, 27 Oct, 29 Oct, 03 Nov; historical points are Internet Archive copies, not repo captures.
Source: OpenCode Data (opencode.ai/data), snapshot 2026-11-03T03:08:34.000Z; historical snapshots: Internet Archive.
